primary_frank_input: FRANK C7 — Clay Organ Runtime Fabric
ancestry_rule: C7, G11, U1 and CC11 share substantial RAE ancestry and are not counted as independent replication. Verdicts rely on independent literature and/or new discriminating CC12 executions.

items.assumption: FRANK C7 runtime ABI should preserve typed collection semantics such as SET, ORDERED, MULTISET and weighted/priority candidates.
independent_support: CC12 E2B 30k typed-vs-type-erased SQLite lowering differential
set/bag semantics literature treating Set and Multiset as distinct collection types
items.counterhypothesis: One universal container/row semantics is sufficient and backend defaults can be normalized after execution.
items.adversarial_result: Type-erased DISTINCT mismatched 16947/30000 and raw bag/order mismatched 16609/30000; universal semantics rejected in constructed family.
items.falsifier: A type-erased compiler preserves declared semantics across adversarial duplicate/order/multiplicity workloads and target backends.

items.assumption: C7/MOSAIC semantic identity and exact provenance/contract-instance identity should remain separate.
independent_support: CC12 E2B reordered/duplicate SET cases preserve semantic hash while contract instances remain distinct
OR-Set/CRDT design independently separates visible set semantics from causal add-tag history
items.counterhypothesis: One canonical identity is sufficient for both equivalence and replay ancestry.
items.adversarial_result: Previous E2B v0.1 produced false semantic inequality when one provenance-bound hash served both roles; v0.2/CC12 separated them.
items.falsifier: A single identity can simultaneously preserve semantic equivalence and exact ancestry without false equality/inequality across target operations.

items.assumption: C7/MRSC critical reader handoffs need exact reader-view binding in addition to canonical identity.
items.counterhypothesis: Binding only canonical source/contract is enough because the compiler is trusted.
items.adversarial_result: CC11 source-only binding left 20112 unsafe projected mutations in its constructed family; exact emitted-view binding removed them there.
items.falsifier: Source-bound receipts detect all emitted-view mutations or target compiler proof makes concrete view binding redundant.

items.assumption: C7 should avoid mandatory verbose JSON on cognition-hot internal ABI paths and use compact typed handles/borrowed buffers where sound.
items.counterhypothesis: Target serialization/IPC overhead is dominated by other costs, making a packed ABI unnecessary or harmful.
items.adversarial_result: CC12 hot cached path was ~3.37 us/round versus ~15.34 us cold identity recomputation, but this is CPython/E2B and not target Rust/C/Android ABI evidence.
items.falsifier: Target runtime benchmark shows no material latency/memory/energy benefit or reveals unacceptable invalidation/safety costs.

items.assumption: UnifiedDB logical query unification can coexist with specialized physical stores if ClayCode preserves result semantics and plan identity.
independent_support: CC12 typed SQLite lowering preserves result semantics in 30000 generated cases
polystore/cross-model query systems and typed IR/compiler evidence
items.counterhypothesis: Logical unification necessarily erases backend-specific semantics or requires physical consolidation.
items.adversarial_result: Type-aware lowering achieved zero mismatches in the synthetic SQLite corpus while type-erased lowerers failed widely; this supports logical unification only when semantic types survive lowering.
items.falsifier: Cross-engine target traces show unavoidable semantic loss or unacceptable overhead despite explicit collection/result contracts.
